I am back!   Until my flight!  No capes involved, sadly.

 

Also, I am happily available to represent the Prime Wardens.  Or the Prime Wardens.  Uh oh, this may get confusing.  (The idea of trademark dispute between reality dopplegangers actually now really appeals to me, I am probably gonna keep thinking about this.)

Huge thanks, congratulations, and "let's do this again!" to everyone involved on both sides of the whole affair.  (Seriously, I would happily team up with you folks for another puzzle hunt sometime!)
